candidates.rationale: This allocation uses rse_len without proper validation. If rse_len contains an unexpectedly large value due to integer overflow or insufficient bounds checking earlier in the code path, this could lead to excessive memory allocation or subsequent buffer overflow vulnerabilities when the allocated memory is used.

This check may be insufficient if rse_len was computed from untrusted input through arithmetic operations that could overflow before this comparison. The check only validates against U32_MAX but doesn't account for potential overflow during calculation.
